The ministry list, ko.wikipedia and the 대통령기록관 schedule give 1996-08-08, hence start_confidence medium (see issues). The successor's 임명장 was given at 09:30 on 1997-08-06, the start the main roster uses for 조정제, so the end is 1997-08-06 by the successor rule. 조선일보 1997-08-07 says he left on the 5th, the announcement day.

issues.desc: Start-date convention for the 8·8 개각 of 1996. The reshuffle was announced on the afternoon of 1996-08-08 and the 임명장 given on the morning of 1996-08-09. This file starts 신상우 on 1996-08-09 (임명장 day), as finance.ext88.json does for 한승수 from the same reshuffle and as the main oceans roster does for 조정제 (1997-08-06, announced 08-05). The mof.go.kr list, ko.wikipedia and the 대통령기록관 schedule give 1996-08-08. science.ext88.json keeps 구본영 at 1996-08-08 for the same reshuffle and says the ict lineage does the same for 강봉균. The lineages should adopt one rule. Under the announcement rule 신상우 would start on 1996-08-08 and the one-day vacancy on that day would disappear.

One-day vacancy on 1996-08-08. The ministry existed in law from that day (법률 제5153호 부칙 제1조 and 대통령령 제15135호 부칙 제1조, 국가기록원 OG0005958) but, under the 임명장 rule, had no minister until 1996-08-09. No 차관 had been appointed yet (reports of 1996-08-09 and 08-10 say the 차관 would follow in a later round), so acting[] is empty.

세계일보 1996-08-10 (BigKinds 01100701.19960810000000204) dates the 8·8 임명장 ceremony to the morning of the 8th. The reshuffle was announced on the afternoon of the 8th (동아일보 1996-08-09, 경인일보 1996-08-09, 매일경제 1996-08-09), and 서울경제, 경인일보, 한겨레, 매일경제 and 연합 (via 전남일보) date the ceremony to the morning of the 9th. The 세계일보 date is treated as an error.

신상우's end. No 이임식 report was found in BigKinds or the News Library for 1997-08-05..08-07. The end follows the successor rule (1997-08-06, the day 조정제 received the 임명장), which matches the mof.go.kr list and ko.wikipedia. 조선일보 1997-08-07 p.10 speaks of him as having left the post on the 5th (the announcement day). Among sibling files, environment.ext88 and agriculture.ext88 end their 8·5 개각 outgoing ministers on 1997-08-06, while justice.ext88 ends 최상엽 on 1997-08-05.
